title: auth.rs catch-all sends untagged NO to authenticate_finish
description: auth.rs handle_authenticate_data catch-all arm (line 174) calls server.authenticate_finish(Status::no(None, None, ...)) with tag=None, producing an untagged NO. RFC 3501 §7.1 defines untagged NO as informational — it does not terminate an AUTHENTICATE exchange. authenticate_finish likely requires a tagged response to exit the authenticating sub-state. Passing an untagged response may leave the imap-next server stuck in authenticating state, causing all subsequent client input to be routed as AuthenticateData events and blocking the session — exactly the failure mode the comment at line 169-173 says this fix prevents.
